snippet.title: Screaming Head - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Screaming Head, a 2D psychedelic platformer developed by JZPS Games. Players will embody a strange head that wields a compulsion to scream at whoever it comes across throughout a vibrantly colorful platforming adventure. Screaming Head is launching on February 16, 2026, for PC (Steam).
